description: Largest battle of the Second Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria.

timeline.summary: On Aerona Jaya fights compleated Ertai and Aron Capashen and is rescued by Radha, then is killed by compleated Ajani at the Mana Rig.
timeline.quote: She was killed by a compleated Ajani Goldmane at the Battle of the Mana Rig .

citation.text: "Jaya Ballard", section "Dominaria United". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A New Coalition forms and confronts the Phyrexians in the Battle of the Mana Rig.
timeline.quote: A New Coalition was formed in Dominaria United when New Phyrexia staged another attack.
